description: This file contains utility functions for handling ARIA roles, accessible names, and related accessibility features in a web environment, including role inference, attribute checks, and content parsing.

methods.name: hasExplicitAccessibleName
methods.description: Checks if an element has an explicit accessible name via aria-label or aria-labelledby.

methods.name: hasGlobalAriaAttribute
methods.description: Determines if an element has any global ARIA attributes, optionally considering role-specific restrictions.

methods.name: hasTabIndex
methods.description: Checks if an element has a valid tabindex attribute.

methods.name: isFocusable
methods.description: Determines if an element is focusable based on native focusability and tabindex.

methods.name: isNativelyFocusable
methods.description: Checks if an element is natively focusable based on its tag and attributes.

methods.name: getImplicitRoleByTagName
methods.description: Infers implicit ARIA roles based on element tag name and attributes.

methods.name: getImplicitAriaRole
methods.description: Computes the implicit ARIA role for an element, considering inheritance and presentation roles.

methods.name: getExplicitAriaRole
methods.description: Retrieves the explicit ARIA role assigned via the role attribute.

methods.name: getAriaRole
methods.description: Determines the effective ARIA role of an element, considering explicit and implicit roles.

methods.name: getAriaBoolean
methods.description: Converts an ARIA boolean attribute string to a boolean or undefined.

methods.name: isElementIgnoredForAria
methods.description: Checks if an element is ignored for ARIA purposes based on tag name.

methods.name: isElementHiddenForAria
methods.description: Determines if an element is hidden from ARIA accessibility tree based on styles and attributes.

methods.name: belongsToDisplayNoneOrAriaHiddenOrNonSlotted
methods.description: Recursively checks if an element is hidden due to display:none, aria-hidden, or shadow DOM considerations.

methods.name: getIdRefs
methods.description: Resolves IDREFs in aria-owns, aria-describedby, etc., to DOM elements.

methods.name: trimFlatString
methods.description: Trims whitespace from a string, used in accessible name/description calculations.

methods.name: asFlatString
methods.description: Converts a string to a normalized flat string for accessible name/description.

methods.name: queryInAriaOwned
methods.description: Queries elements within aria-owns relationships.

methods.name: getCSSContent
methods.description: Retrieves the CSS content property for an element, considering pseudo-elements.

methods.name: parseCSSContentPropertyAsString
methods.description: Parses the CSS content property into a string, supporting attr() and string tokens.

methods.name: getAriaLabelledByElements
methods.description: Gets elements referenced by aria-labelledby.

methods.name: allowsNameFromContent
methods.description: Determines if an element's role allows name from content based on ARIA spec.

methods.name: getElementAccessibleName
methods.description: Computes the accessible name for an element following W3C ARIA spec.

methods.name: getElementAccessibleDescription
methods.description: Computes the accessible description for an element.

methods.name: getAriaInvalid
methods.description: Gets the ARIA invalid state of an element.

methods.name: getValidityInvalid
methods.description: Checks if an element's validity state is invalid.

methods.name: getElementAccessibleErrorMessage
methods.description: Retrieves the error message associated with an element via aria-errormessage or validation.

methods.name: getTextAlternativeInternal
methods.description: Recursively computes the text alternative for an element, considering ARIA and CSS.

methods.name: innerAccumulatedElementText
methods.description: Accumulates text content from an element and its children for accessible name calculation.

methods.name: getAriaSelected
methods.description: Determines if an element is selected according to ARIA.

methods.name: getAriaChecked
methods.description: Gets the checked state of an element with ARIA roles supporting checked.

methods.name: getCheckedAllowMixed
methods.description: Gets checked state allowing 'mixed'.

methods.name: getCheckedWithoutMixed
methods.description: Gets checked state disallowing 'mixed'.

methods.name: getChecked
methods.description: Internal function to determine checked state, considering indeterminate and ARIA attributes.

methods.name: getReadonly
methods.description: Determines if an element is readonly based on ARIA and native attributes.

methods.name: getAriaPressed
methods.description: Gets the pressed state of a toggle button.

methods.name: getAriaExpanded
methods.description: Gets the expanded state of an element supporting aria-expanded.

methods.name: getAriaLevel
methods.description: Gets the ARIA level of a heading, listitem, row, or treeitem.

methods.name: getAriaDisabled
methods.description: Checks if an element is disabled via native or ARIA attributes.

methods.name: isNativelyDisabled
methods.description: Checks if an element is natively disabled (e.g., button, input).

methods.name: belongsToDisabledOptGroup
methods.description: Checks if an option belongs to a disabled optgroup.

methods.name: belongsToDisabledFieldSet
methods.description: Checks if an element belongs to a disabled fieldset.

methods.name: hasExplicitAriaDisabled
methods.description: Recursively checks for aria-disabled attribute in element hierarchy.

methods.name: receivesPointerEvents
methods.description: Determines if an element receives pointer events, considering CSS and shadow DOM.
